title: Mixed-anion templated cage-like lanthanide clusters: Gd27 and Dy27

synthesis.procedure: Sodium propionate (0.096 g, 1.0 mmol) and aqueous Gd(ClO4)3 (3 mL, 3.0 mmol) were added to anhydrous ethanol (10 mL) and deionized water (3 mL). The solution was heated to about 80 °C; freshly prepared aqueous NaOH (1.0 M) was added dropwise until incipient permanent precipitation. The mixture was stirred under reflux for 2 h, filtered hot, and the filtrate evaporated under ambient conditions to give colorless crystals.

reagents.name: aqueous sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 1.0 M; added dropwise to incipient permanent precipitation

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered while hot; filtrate evaporated under ambient conditions to afford colorless crystals.

properties.summary: The Gd27 cluster shows predominantly antiferromagnetic interactions and a large magnetocaloric effect.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete Gd27 cage comprises a Gd16 ring assembled from four Gd4 units, joined to another Gd4 unit to form a bowl and capped by a Gd7 unit. Carbonate bridges help form the cage, which encapsulates a perchlorate anion; propionate ligands and coordinated water stabilize the exterior.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the explicitly shared procedure for compound 1, substituting aqueous Dy(ClO4)3 for Gd(ClO4)3: sodium propionate and the lanthanide perchlorate were added to ethanol and water, heated to about 80 °C, treated dropwise with 1.0 M aqueous NaOH until incipient permanent precipitation, stirred under reflux for 2 h, filtered hot, and crystallized by evaporation of the filtrate under ambient conditions.

properties.summary: The anisotropic Dy27 cluster displays slow magnetization relaxation. No out-of-phase susceptibility maximum was observed in the measured range, so the reported relaxation parameters are rough estimates from a Debye-model treatment rather than an Arrhenius fit.
